Hi Sophie / Markus —

Thanks for the context. Short answer: Redwood Procurement requires a PO for purchases above our $10k threshold. For smaller engagements we can consider a temporary invoice-only path for pilots, subject to evidence and a documented exception approval.

For an exception we need the following before I can approve:
1) Completed vendor onboarding form (returned to procurement inbox)
2) W-9 or applicable tax form for your legal entity
3) Certificate of Insurance naming Redwood Inference as additional insured (or waiver if not applicable)
4) Confirmation of total pilot value and billing cadence (one invoice at completion or monthly)

If the pilot total is under $10k and you supply items 1–3, Procurement can approve a 90-day invoice-only pilot with two business constraints:
- Approval will be timeboxed (pilot only); any renewal/expansion requiring a longer term will require a PO or SOW with PO reference.
- Finance will place a single-cycle hold to verify invoice and delivery; payments still follow Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated.

I’ve attached the procurement checklist for your reference.

Laura Bennett
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
